limitations: Adjacent discoveries only; no global covariance extremum is claimed; the diffuse-tail optimum is family-specific; an equivalent formula in older urn or occupancy literature remains the main originality risk.
scientific_summary: For iid sampling from any countable species law, the covariance of two consecutive discovery indicators equals the variance of the current missing mass minus the exact one-step depletion term; finite laws realize both covariance signs at every burn-in n.
